fields.name: cash
fields.role: liquid capital available before/after monthly decisions

fields.name: funded_exposure
fields.role: new capital committed in the current month

fields.name: repayments
fields.role: principal plus interest cash returned this month

fields.name: defaults
fields.role: number of default events realized this month under common path

fields.name: recoveries
fields.role: cash recovered after default under internal LGD proxy

fields.name: ECL
fields.role: proxy expected credit loss on active outstanding loans

fields.name: budget_remaining
fields.role: cash not currently committed after funding

fields.name: capital_used
fields.role: active outstanding plus current funded amount

fields.name: stage_mix
fields.role: Stage 2 proxy share based on PD/width stress

fields.name: coverage_state
fields.role: historical online conformal gate inherited from v9

fields.name: wealth
fields.role: cash plus outstanding minus ECL proxy

claim_boundary: dynamic replay/simulation over static historical data; no production deployment or forecast claim
